body: Stocks are on track for modest weekly gains, despite a volatile post-FOMC reaction in the bond market. stocks are mostly higher near the highs of the day
Company earnings have been strong, with consensus analyst estimates suggesting an outlook for continued strength globally.
Stocks could continue their historic bull market run, but higher oil prices sparked by the Iran conflict could weigh on markets.
